changelog: External-key path is primary; OWS repositioned as optional key store (per-agent OWS registrations closed); new Polymarket-import path (import_polymarket_wallet, SDK 0.24.4+).
summary: Self-custody wallet setup for Simmer agents. Bring your own key, import a funded Polymarket wallet, or connect an existing dashboard-registered agent to your local runtime. Skip this skill if you use a managed wallet — managed setup is a one-time dashboard flow, not an agent task.
